observations: The draft-04 logical-size four-view sheet and direct native images retain the useful cool violet crown/slate side palette and vivid folded green accents from draft-03.

Increasing height while retaining similar XY outlines lengthens the upright sidewalls. N and W particularly read as long chamfered columns, and E reads as two tall cylinders; this is a regression against broad uneven boulder volume. S preserves three crown steps but is also more vertical.

The wider phone pan now exposes more violet crowns and outer silhouettes. Existing separate potted plants still dominate the left edge; raising the model does not provide an appropriate substitute for the intended consumer composition.

Coordinator has accepted the plant density and occlusion as a consumer layout issue and is revising actual spacing/depth lanes. This will be assessed on recaptured real page evidence, without demanding greater model height.

Crevice foliage still contains isolated vertical blades/slivers and small flat triangular-looking flaps, particularly on foreground W and E crevices. The larger A clump reads better than the smaller B clump.
